$comment: Recommended module sets offered at first run. Each pack is a LIST of catalog module_ids - nothing is bundled; every module is still downloaded and verified from the signed official catalog. To add a tier, append an object to "packs". Fields: pack_id (unique, lowercase), languages (BCP-47 tags it is offered for), name and description (shown to the user), version, module_ids (installed in this order; an id the catalog does not offer is skipped). A catalog that publishes its own starter_packs with the same pack_id takes precedence. `npm run setup -- --select=<pack_id>` installs the same list.

packs.name: Essentials
packs.description: Two Bible translations with commentaries, cross-references, Strong's lexicons, dictionaries and topical indexes - everything the study tools use.
